source_proposal.rationale: The dining room loses its TV, so the living room has to become a good TV room without losing conversation. Turning the sofa to face the fireplace gives three straight-on seats at 97 in from the screen. The swivels turn between the TV and the group, and the three doorways at the west end share one 72-in walkway behind the sofa. Only a coffee table is bought. Trade-offs: the desk leaves; the cognac sofa has no place; look-up is at the 15-degree limit if the screen centre is 66 in (measure it). New cost $399.
